scripts.supabase:db:push:dry: dotenv-cli -e .env -- bash -c 'supabase link --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase db push --dry-run --remote'
scripts.supabase:db:push: dotenv-cli -e .env -- bash -c 'supabase link --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase db push --remote --yes'
scripts.supabase:db:push:dry:staging: dotenv-cli -e .env.staging -- bash -c 'supabase link --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase db push --dry-run --remote'
scripts.supabase:db:push:staging: dotenv-cli -e .env.staging -- bash -c 'supabase link --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase db push --remote --yes'
scripts.supabase:deploy-functions: dotenv-cli -e .env -- bash -c 'supabase functions deploy generate-invoice-pdf --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase functions deploy send-invoice --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase functions deploy send-loan-message --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase functions deploy ocr_scripture_refs --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase functions deploy email-inbound-task --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF && supabase functions deploy transcribe_study_note --project-ref $SUPABASE_REF'
scripts.supabase:gen-types: dotenv-cli -e .env -- bash -c 'supabase gen types --lang typescript --schema public --remote > src/lib/types/database.ts'
scripts.supabase:ship: npm run check && npm run supabase:db:push:dry && echo '\nDry run OK. Review above, then run: npm run supabase:ship:apply'
scripts.supabase:ship:apply: npm run check && npm run supabase:db:push && npm run supabase:deploy-functions
scripts.ship-library: npm run check && npm run supabase:db:push:dry && echo '\nDry run OK. Review above, then run: npm run ship-library:apply'
scripts.ship-library:apply: npm run check && npm run supabase:db:push && npm run supabase:gen-types && npm run test && npm run supabase:deploy-functions
